label: NPM1::MLF1

sections.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome assembly and protein trafficking.
MLF1 encodes a regulator of hematopoietic cell differentiation and survival.

The t(3;5) fusion joins amino-terminal NPM1 sequences to MLF1 and alters intracellular regulation in hematopoietic cells. It is a rare recurrent AML fusion, distinct from the common NPM1 exon 12 mutation.
